subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 4 – Lesson 7: Skills – Reading (I love my job!)
outcomes: Read about four amazing jobs and find information.
Decide if sentences about the text are true or false.
Give your opinion: interesting, boring, dangerous or exciting.

tf.s: Warren draws the people in video games and makes them move.
tf.why: Yes! Warren is a video game animator.

tf.s: Drawing people in video games is very quick.
tf.why: An animator must work very slowly and carefully.
Correct! Martina is a zoo vet.

tf.s: Martina sees birds, snakes, turtles, giraffes and elephants.
tf.why: Well done! She sees many animals.

tf.s: Mike makes sounds for TV programmes and films.
tf.why: Yes! Mike is a sound artist.

tf.s: Mike moves a pair of shoes to make the sound of a bird's wings.
tf.why: He moves a pair of gloves.

tf.s: Alison's rockets take people into space.
tf.why: Correct! To the International Space Station.
Mike works in a studio. Martina works in a zoo.
Alison is a rocket engineer. She builds rockets.

tf.s: 'I think the sound artist's job is very interesting' is an opinion.
